name: Maru Mini 3x3 (30mm)
description: The Maru Mini 3x3 measures just 3cm across, making it almost twice as small as most conventional 3x3 cubes. For such a small cube, it features a robust internal mechanism and turns smoothly right out of the box. The Maru Mini 3x3 is available in a variety of colors, including transparent and glow-in-the-dark. The "Dice" color features fancy dice patterns across the cube in place of the colors.
